title: Add sign-out
description: Adds POST /api/auth/logout. It ends the session, clears the session cookie and sends the browser to the page in `next`, a path on this site, or to the home page. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: Checking only that `next` starts with `/` lets `//evil.example` (and `/\evil.example`) through, which browsers treat as another site: an open redirect usable for phishing.
